description: This is a source file for a routing component of a language model API platform, specifically the 'router.py' module from the litellm project. It defines the Router class, which manages model deployment, request routing, response caching, fallback mechanisms, and integrations with various services and strategies for model selection and load balancing.

classes.name: Router
classes.description: The main class responsible for managing deployment configurations, routing strategies, request handling, fallbacks, and integrations for the language model platform.

methods.name: apply_default_settings
methods.description: Method to apply default settings to the router instance, such as optional pre-call checks.

methods.name: discard
methods.description: Method to clean up callbacks and resources when the router is no longer in use.

methods.description: Initializes RedisCache or RedisClusterCache based on the configuration.

methods.name: _update_redis_cache
methods.description: Updates the router's Redis cache if none is currently set.

methods.name: routing_strategy_init
methods.description: Sets up the routing strategy (e.g., least busy, latency) and associated logging handlers.

methods.name: initialize_assistants_endpoint
methods.description: Initializes assistant-related API endpoints for the router.

methods.name: initialize_router_endpoints
methods.description: Initializes core and specialized API endpoints for the router.

methods.name: validate_fallbacks
methods.description: Validates the structure and format of fallback configurations.

methods.name: add_optional_pre_call_checks
methods.description: Adds optional pre-call checks such as prompt caching, cooldowns, or deployment checks.

methods.name: print_deployment
methods.description: Returns a deployment copy with masked API keys for safe logging or display.

methods.name: completion
methods.description: Public method to perform a completion request with fallback handling.

methods.description: Internal method to perform model completion with available deployment.

methods.description: Asynchronous method to perform a streaming or non-streaming completion with fallback handling.

methods.description: Helper to iterate over streaming responses and handle mid-stream fallbacks.
